_comment: How long a journal gives an author to return an amendment, when the email
does not say. These are ASSUMPTIONS: anything derived from them is marked
'assumed' in the tracker and reads as 'assumed, not stated by the journal'
wherever it is shown. A date the email states always wins over this table.
Journal names are matched loosely, so 'International Orthopaedics' also
catches 'International Orthopaedics (SICOT)'. Correct a number here when
you learn a journal's real window.
